description: Toll Brothers was founded in 1967 by brothers Robert and Bruce Toll in Pennsylvania as a builder of luxury homes. The company went public in 1986 and expanded nationwide, eventually moving into urban high-rises, active adult communities, and resort properties. Over the decades, Toll Brothers has grown into a leading U.S. builder of luxury homes, operating in 24 states and the District of Columbia. Today it designs, builds, and sells high-end homes, condominiums, and rental communities, and offers related services such as mortgage, insurance, and smart-home technology.

title: Toll Brothers

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Women
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"There is so much that I could say to express my gratitude for Toll Brothers; however, the overall theme is that there has never been a time that I didn't feel like I was a part of a team. Management and higher-ups have always been approachable, and I have never been afraid to ask a question. I love and appreciate that Toll has challenged me in so many areas to try new things and be the best team member I can be. The progressive attitude is something that I take pride in and brag about. I often tell friends and family that I found something that I love so it doesn't feel like work; I get to be here and help people with their homes and I couldn't be more proud of the work we do."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Construction
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"For a national public company and high up in the homebuilder industry, the overall culture both nationally and divisionally does not feel very corporate.  Working here feels more like family, and surrounded by a big bunch of relatives all over - near and far.  Everyone is approachable.  It is a positive corporate culture that is fostered by its leadership who are effective, supportive, empathetic, and approachable.  Thank you for making every effort to provide clear communication, opportunities for growth, collaboration, reward systems, and a strong sense of purpose.  It is great place to work and be a part of!"

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Women
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"Toll Brothers is the best place of work I have ever had. I have developed the confidence and trust within myself to perform my duties well. Toll offers so many resources to be good at your job (training, senior employees with loads of knowledge and online tools). I don't even like using the term 'job'. I see this as a long-term career and with long-term success. It has challenged me in ways that I didn't know I had to grow in. I have learned so much. I interact with most all departments on a daily basis and I consider them all my work-family. When things get tough or something is missed, we communicate well to get it all resolved quickly and efficiently."

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: Revenues at the luxury homebuilder were essentially flat last year, and earnings sank 21%. The main culprit: slowing demand in a key market, California. Its stock was down sharply in the first few months of 2020 on fears of a coronavirus-driven slump in home sales.

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Millennials
rankings.itemDescription: Luxury home builder Toll Brothers has built a high-quality home for its workforce. The company hosts free dinners on Monday and holds occasional fireside chats with CEO Douglas Yearley. Employees are allowed to rent—and vacation at —properties the company owns across the country for discounted prices. Plus, the company bagged the no. 628 spot on this year’s Fortune 1000 list. “You are given ample responsibilities and your success is pretty much in your hands,” says one worker. Read the Great Place to Work review.
